SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_event_log
AND event_type = #{eventType}

SELECT e.event_log_id::TEXT AS row_id, e.event_type, c.code_nm AS event_type_nm, e.user_id, e.target_table, e.target_id, e.device_type, e.user_agent, e.reg_dt, e.reg_ip FROM t_event_log e LEFT JOIN t_code c ON c.code_id = e.event_type AND c.p_code_id = 'EVENT00' WHERE e.event_log_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_event_log (event_type, user_id, target_table, target_id, device_type, user_agent, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{userId}, #{targetTable}, #{targetId}, #{deviceType}, #{userAgent}, NOW(), #{regIp})
